</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

 "brief": "## Problem\nWhen a policyholder reports the same incident through multiple channels—typically phone and web portal—the Keelwater system creates separate, duplicate claims without alerting users. This duplicate loss report scenario causes confusion in financial reserves, complicates reporting, and disrupts supplier coordination because the duplicates go undetected at intake.\n\n## Who is affected\n- **Pendleford Motor Mutual** reports that when a policyholder reports the same incident both by phone and through the web portal, the system doesn’t alert them — it just creates separate claims [i:055ee693c115b5fa].\n- **Sallowmere Motor** states the same incident came in both by phone and through the portal, and now they’ve got separate claims with no alert to flag it [i:0990586a589ee5d4].\n- **Tarnholt Drive Cover** explains that when a policyholder reports a loss both by phone and through the web portal, the system doesn’t flag it as a potential duplicate, complicating reserves and payments [i:770a21dd38be8e96].\n\n## Evidence\n- The issue has been mentioned 15 times across 7 accounts [i:055ee693c115b5fa][i:0990586a589ee5d4][i:1e580d536eb9e7c2][i:2c33fe6917ce149e][i:2c50b8970e846b52][i:5e36c618d9ac324f][i:6f58319920963914][i:7572aacb13bfbab0][i:770a21dd38be8e96][i:7d53d00296e4475f][i:847e58c1a543471c][i:8ec45cfe56e665e5][i:b658a07ed97377d2][i:dc8f04a38773b0c3][i:e662b0d940a820b4].\n- Mentions have come through 3 routes: onboarding (3 mentions), sales (3 mentions), and support (9 mentions) [i:055ee693c115b5fa][i:0990586a589ee5d4][i:1e580d536eb9e7c2].\n- The total Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from these accounts is £5,220,000.0 [i:055ee693c115b5fa][i:0990586a589ee5d4][i:1e580d536eb9e7c2].\n- **Hollinbrook Home Insurance** (ARR £2,400,000.0) has seen the same loss reported through two channels with no system warning, creating a duplicate loss report [i:7572aacb13bfbab0].\n- **Callowfield Auto Assurance** (ARR £1,250,000.0) reports several instances where the same loss gets reported twice, creating duplicate claims and messing up reserves and reporting [i:b658a07ed97377d2].\n- **Ravensgill Insurance** (ARR £470,000.0) and **Orrinbury Fleet Insurance** (ARR £120,000.0) have also reported getting the same claim via multiple channels without an alert at intake [i:2c50b8970e846b52][i:e662b0d940a820b4].\n- **Tarnholt Drive Cover** (ARR £290,000.0) states they are manually cross-checking every new claim to avoid duplicates, which eats up time [i:1e580d536eb9e7c2].\n- **Orrinbury Fleet Insurance** also mentions spotting disabled UI buttons that should allow linking but don’t work [i:e662b0d940a820b4].\n- In the last 90 days, 0 renewals have occurred among these accounts [i:055ee693c115b5fa][i:0990586a589ee5d4][i:1e580d536eb9e7c2].\n\n## Why now\n- The problem is actively being reported by customers across all three contact routes (onboarding, sales, and support) as of late 2026 [i:055ee693c115b5fa][i:0990586a589ee5d4][i:1e580d536eb9e7c2].\n- Multiple accounts with significant ARR, including **Hollinbrook Home Insurance** (£2,400,000.0) and **Callowfield Auto Assurance** (£1,250,000.0), have explicitly cited this issue, indicating it affects key revenue-generating customers [i:7572aacb13bfbab0][i:b658a07ed97377d2].\n- The manual workaround described by **Tarnholt Drive Cover**—cross-checking every new claim—highlights an increasing operational burden as the problem persists [i:1e580d536eb9e7c2].\n- The issue directly impacts core claims-handling functions like reserve accuracy and supplier coordination, which are critical for customer retention, especially with several accounts (e.g., **Pendleford Motor Mutual**, **Tarnholt Drive Cover**, **Hollinbrook Home Insurance**) having renewal dates in early 2027 [i:055ee693c115b5fa][i:770a21dd38be8e96][i:7572aacb13bfbab0].\n",
